final_candidates.decision_summary: Neutralizes an acidic residue in the HA2 coiled-coil, removing unfavorable electrostatic repulsion and stabilizing the prefusion stem conformation.
Increases alpha-helical propensity within HA2 helix A, reinforcing backbone rigidity and resistance to thermal denaturation.
Replaces a polar threonine with isoleucine to optimize core hydrophobic packing in the HA2 central stalk helix.

stop_reason.detail: Top-3 mutations targeting prefusion stalk stabilization have converged and are fully verified against the WT sequence.

history.rationale: Corresponds to HA2 K58I, which packs favorably near the fusion peptide to suppress premature acid activation and markedly boost prefusion stability.
While K387I improves local hydrophobic interactions, it is slightly downranked compared to G379A which more directly restores helical backbone rigidity.
Corresponds to HA2 D112N, removing a critical pH-sensitive electrostatic repulsive trigger in the stem coiled-coil to enhance thermal and acid stability.
D441N neutralizes an acidic residue in the HA2 coiled-coil, eliminating electrostatic repulsion and strongly stabilizing the prefusion stem.
Corresponds to HA2 T107I, optimizing core hydrophobic packing within the central helical bundle of the prefusion stalk.
T436I introduces a hydrophobic residue into the HA2 long alpha-helix, reinforcing core hydrophobic packing and thermal stability.
Corresponds to HA1 H18Q, eliminating a low-pH protonation site adjacent to the fusion peptide pocket to prevent premature triggering and inactivation.
H18Q removes a pH-sensing histidine near the fusion peptide pocket, raising the barrier to premature low-pH conformational transition.
Neutralizes the negative charge at HA2 position 112, stabilizing the prefusion trimer against low-pH conformational changes and thermal denaturation.
Retained as an alternative neutralization at position 441, though D441N offers better hydrogen-bonding potential.
Corresponds to HA2 G50A, replacing a helix-breaking glycine in stem helix A with alanine to enhance helical propensity and overall rigidity.
Replacing Gly with Ala within HA2 helix A dramatically increases alpha-helical propensity without disrupting quaternary packing.
Corresponds to HA2 Q105L, improving hydrophobic core interactions and quaternary interface stability within the HA2 trimeric coiled-coil.
Leucine at position 434 improves coiled-coil hydrophobic packing in HA2 while preserving overall heptad repeat periodicity.
Stabilizes the HA1-HA2 interface via favorable aromatic packing near the fusion peptide cavity, decreasing susceptibility to environmental degradation.
Retained to target the fusion cluster pH sensor, stabilizing the prefusion stem against environmental acidification.
Corresponds to HA2 D46N, mitigating unfavorable electrostatic repulsion along helix A in the prefusion trimer state.
Retained for charge neutralization on HA2 helix A to modestly improve environmental stability.
Provides an alternative hydrophobic substitution at HA2 position 58, stabilizing the stem pocket against premature structural rearrangement.
Retained as a conservative hydrophobic alternative to K387I with lower oxidation resistance.
